latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of agent-memory-tiers: structured, self-updating memory for OpenClaw agents.

- Provides a two-tier memory system (L0 state snapshot, L1 7-day rolling context) for instant onboard context at every activation.
- Prevents token waste by eliminating the cold-start context problem in agents.
- Includes setup steps with example templates for L0.md and L1.md files, along with guidance for integrating into agent workflows.
- Designed for multi-agent swarms; enables quick agent status checks and coordination via L0/L1 files.
- Tested across a 20-agent production swarm, delivering significant token savings per activation.
